svg.title: Whole-substrate command-center map
svg.desc: A logical map of 15,750 unique command centers across 45 cells and eight heads. Double rings mark 992 lane-start positions recorded twice in the Excel raw coordinate columns.
svg.text: Dot = unique command center · double ring = same position recorded twice in Excel Raw · DOE 4×4 branches are not expanded
Cell Align X increases · 100 mm pitch
Cell Align Y increases · 200 mm pitch

g.text: Double ring = identical position recorded twice
Schematic: cell grids are enlarged; the outline is not a verified physical glass boundary.
